summary: native-frontend-orb preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs (obfuscator.io-style _0xNNNN identifiers) downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727 KB file consisting of a shuffled string-array rotator (WV8StW) and a base64-alphabet decoder (hc1jfK9), the canonical obfuscator.io output shape. There is no native source and no library entry point (the declared main index.js is absent from the tarball); the README presents the package as a CircleCI orb wrapper for Ornikar's internal mobile CI, a purpose that has no need for a second language runtime. The package is published unscoped while the repository is ornikar/orb-frontend-native, matching a dependency-confusion shape against @ornikar's internal orb: any Ornikar build resolving the unscoped name at npm install runs the dropped Bun binary against the obfuscated payload on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
